project.name: AI-first Leadership Portfolio
project.vision: A public leadership portfolio that shows how Brandon turns AI-first strategy into responsible, measurable organizational outcomes.

primaryProblem.title: Leadership impact is hard to evaluate from a résumé alone
primaryProblem.description: Hiring leaders and executives can see a résumé or polished case study but often cannot inspect the reasoning, requirements, validation, and learning behind the work. This makes it harder to understand how Brandon would lead AI-first change, govern risk, and measure outcomes.

solutionSpace.overview: A public portfolio presents leadership experience, AI-first operating principles, selected demonstrations, and an inspectable engineering quality area with traceable requirements, automated test evidence, single-pass performance checks, and security guidance.

capabilities.name: Explore leadership evidence
capabilities.description: Visitors can review selected experience, case studies, operating principles, and interactive demonstrations.

capabilities.name: Inspect engineering practice
capabilities.description: Visitors can inspect approved requirements, acceptance criteria, relationships, statuses, and test evidence that demonstrate how the portfolio is developed.

capabilities.name: Review quality signals
capabilities.description: Visitors can see unit, integration, browser, single-pass performance, and security review results with clear limits and links to source evidence.

capabilities.name: Follow work through issues
capabilities.description: The owner can connect actionable findings to GitHub issues and iterate on them through the development workflow.

personas.name: Hiring leader
personas.description: An executive or hiring manager evaluating Brandon for AI, technology, or transformation leadership.
goals: Understand leadership approach and evidence quickly
Inspect how ideas become accountable, validated outcomes

personas.name: Portfolio owner
personas.description: Brandon, maintaining the portfolio and using its public requirements and quality workflow to show how he develops.
goals: Use automated checks and evidence to improve the site
